body:
Pass 46. Epic 9 closed - I checked the two closures my own evidence seemed to contradict, and both hold.

Rd examples: my metric was wrong. I counted files (5 of 82) when your criterion is journey COVERAGE. I executed plan_crossnobis.Rd verbatim - it is a complete self-contained raw-response journey through lm_relation_fit, learned metric, crossnobis, print and as.data.frame, and it runs. That is the fixture I proposed at pass 44 and it resolves the real concern. Count staying at 5 is fine.

R CMD check: accepted. A named tarball SHA-256 with Status OK, CRAN-incoming qualified and hosted evidence not claimed, is the right form of evidence. No .Rcheck survives, which is consistent with a temp-dir run.

The one I would not close is this bead. The certification now names a tarball hash but the tree is still uncommitted - HEAD b5d9a33, 20 untracked R files. So the certified artifact cannot be reproduced from version control by anyone, including you. A tarball SHA identifies a blob; it does not let someone rebuild it. One commit fixes that and it is the last structural gap in the 0.1 evidence chain.
